# 🌆 Jaipur — 3-Day Trip  
> **Delhi → Jaipur** · 20 Nov 2026 – 22 Nov 2026 · 2 people · Budget ₹20,000 · Estimated total ₹14,180  

## ✨ At a glance
- **Getting there:** Delhi → Jaipur — 3A train, 4 h 30 m, ₹510 pp (₹1,020 total)  
- **Stay:** Hotel Rajasthan Palace – ₹2,930 /night, 3★, free Wi‑Fi & breakfast, book on Booking.com  
- **Weather:** Pleasant ≈ 22‑28 °C, dry, light sweater for evenings  
- **Total cost:** ₹14,180 of ₹20,000 budget (₹5,820 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back
- **Go:** 12431 Jaipur Express (Delhi Junction → Jaipur Junction) – ₹510 pp, 4 h 30 m, AC 3A  
- **Return:** 12432 Jaipur Express (Jaipur Junction → Delhi Junction) – ₹510 pp, 4 h 30 m, AC 3A  
- **Why this option:** Cheapest comfortable AC option; saves ~₹4,000 vs flight and avoids road traffic.  

## 🏨 Where to stay
1. **Hotel Rajasthan Palace** — ₹2,930 /night · 3★ · free Wi‑Fi, breakfast, rooftop view · book on Booking.com  
2. **Hotel Shikha Jaipur** — ₹2,400 /night · 3★ · complimentary breakfast, central location · book on MakeMyTrip  
3. **Hotel Kalyan** — ₹2,600 /night · 3★ · free Wi‑Fi, garden lounge · book on OYO  

## 🗓️ Day-by-day plan
### Day 1 — Fri, 20 Nov · Arrival & Old City Intro  
- **6:30 AM** — Board 12431 train at New Delhi (Platform 4)  
- **11:00 AM** — Arrive Jaipur Junction, take prepaid auto (₹150) to hotel, check‑in, drop bags  
- **12:30 PM** — Lunch at **Rawat Misthan Bhandar** — Pyaz Kachori, ₹180 pp  
- **2:00 PM** — Walk to **Hawa Mahal** (0.5 km, 5 min) – Entry free, photo stop  
- **3:30 PM** — Explore **Jantar Mantar** (0.3 km, 3 min) – Entry ₹100 pp  
- **5:00 PM** – Stroll through **Bapu Bazaar** for textiles (2 km, 10 min)  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Kalkatta Chaat Bhandar** — Dal Kachori, ₹200 pp  
- 💡 *Tip:* Carry a small bottle of water; Jaipur’s sun can be strong even in November.  

### Day 2 — Sat, 21 Nov · Forts & Heritage  
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included)  
- **9:00 AM** — Taxi to **Amber Fort** (≈ 11 km, 30 min, ₹300 round) – Entry ₹100 pp, Elephant ride optional (₹300 pp)  
- **12:30 PM** — Lunch at **1135 AD – The Restaurant** (inside Amber complex) — Dal Bati Churma set, ₹350 pp  
- **2:00 PM** — Visit **Jaigarh Fort** (2 km, 5 min) – Entry ₹100 pp, enjoy cannon view  
- **4:00 PM** — Return to city, stop at **City Palace** (3 km, 10 min) – Entry ₹200 pp  
- **6:30 PM** — Evening tea & snacks at **Gulab Ji ki Chai** — Chai & Bun Makhhan, ₹120 pp  
- **8:00 PM** — Dinner at **Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB)** — Thali (Dal Bati Churma), ₹300 pp  
- 💡 *Tip:* Wear comfortable shoes; forts involve uneven steps.  

### Day 3 — Sun, 22 Nov · Shopping & Return  
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel, check‑out, store luggage at reception  
- **9:00 AM** — Head to **Johari Bazaar** (1 km, 5 min) – shop for jewellery & gems  
- **11:30 AM** — Light snack at **Gulab Ji ki Chai** – Samosa, ₹100 pp  
- **12:30 PM** — Return to hotel, collect luggage, take auto to railway station (₹150)  
- **2:00 PM** — Board 12432 train back to Delhi  
- **6:30 PM** — Arrive Delhi, end of trip

- **Dal Bati Churma** at **LMB** — ₹300 pp

- **Chai & Bun Makhhan** at **Gulab Ji ki Chai** — ₹120 pp

## 🎒 Weather & packing  
- Daytime 22‑28 °C, clear skies – light cotton shirts & trousers.  
- Evenings can dip to 15 °C – carry a light sweater or shawl.  
- Comfortable walking shoes for forts and bazaars.  
- Sunscreen & sunglasses for midday sun.  

## 🏧 Useful nearby  
- **ATM:** State Bank of India – Bapu Bazaar, 200 m  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil, Jaipur‑Badi Road, 5 km from hotel  
- **Hospital:** Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Hospital – C‑Road, 3 km, +91‑141‑260 5555  
- **Bus stand / Railway station:** Jaipur Junction (Junction), 3 km from hotel  

## 💡 Local tips  
- Carry a photocopy of your ID for entry tickets.  
- Hire auto‑rickshaws with meter; agree on fare before start.  
- Indian tourists get lower entry fees (₹100‑200) – show ID.  
- Bargain politely in markets; start at 50 % of quoted price.  
- Keep a small bottle of hand sanitizer; many eateries lack hand‑wash facilities.
